items.title: Richard Wyands interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: Most of my records I’ve used Peter Washington and Kenny Washington.

ctx.x: Who is on your first call list of bass players. If you line up a duo gig, and who can I call for this, who do you like to get?

Well I like to get Lisle Atkinson. I usually call him first when I get some work. We have a good rapport. We’ve known each other and we’ve played together for many, many years. He has good ears, good facility, and he knows a lot of tunes. And that really means a lot. And I love him. And he’s very dependable. I don’t have to worry about him being late or not showing or something. He’s always there, always, and that means a lot. I don’t know, there are a lot of people that I’ve thought about through the years, bass…
They’re quite popular these days, aren’t they?
